BUILD QUEUE, item B3 of B1-B11 (the /loop from the 2026-09-10 slate's next_direction). B1 (481221f45884, first seal under the seal) and B2 (299d4f72ae40, an open reading is not silently converted) were PROVED and pushed in earlier windows. B3 (8e5db5f3edb2, the verdict door runs the instrument it is handed) is PROVED and pushed this window: cairn HEAD 8781cd7, commons HEAD 89eeedd. The door now extracts each criterion's command, runs it, and refuses a reported outcome its re-run disagrees with; a criterion with no runnable command is refused by name; a TIMEOUT is refused as a timeout and never folded into disagreement; and what the door observed (command, exit, seconds, tail) lands in the berthed artifact, stamped before the digest that names the file. All five falsifier clauses measured green and were then re-run by write_verdict itself on this very build (8 criteria, 8 agreements). Verdict berthed at ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/verdict-20260911T102447-29ff9d6573af.json; all eight chart berths deposited.

THREE DEFECTS FOUND AGAINST THE INSTRUMENTS AND FIXED INSIDE THE VOYAGE, under the bounds ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage. (1) hollow.py called four RECORD files hollow (two validations, history.json, state.json). A record reds nothing by construction, so reporting it as 'hollow' collapses 'unpinnable' into 'possibly hollow' -- two findings that send a builder to opposite work (Law 7). SKIP_RECORD now classes them, closed by NAME so constraint_set.json and the charters stay measured; measure()'s pre-existing empty-set red keeps it from being an escape hatch. Measured through hollow's own writes_to() resolver: 34 of 194 tickets (17%) name at least one record, 52 entries in all. (2) My first census of that walked every decompose packet ever berthed instead of the standing berth per ticket and read 43 of 286 -- wrong; both numbers are in the code comment so the mistake stays legible. (3) THE EVIDENCE RECORD ITSELF: my first PROVEME crossing named test_chart_verdict.py and test_falsifier_verdict.py in also_proven_by because criterion 6 runs them as a regression check. The coverage rung reads that field as a claim that a proof COVERS the boat, and neither does -- this ticket's five clauses are all about write_verdict/inspect_verdict. The clearance gate refused twice. Writing PROVES entries into those proofs to get past it would have manufactured coverage (Law 8's worse-than-a-red), so the RECORD was corrected: a retreat to TICKETME and a re-crossed BUILDME, which is the cut crossings.proven_by_since_buildme calls 'the WHOLE of the kick-back protection'. Nothing in the tree changed on the retreat.

open_threads:
MY READ, NOT RATIFIED: the finding this voyage ends on is about the chart leg, not the builder -- nothing at the PROVEME crossing tells a builder that also_proven_by is a COVERAGE claim rather than a log of what was run. The field name reads like the second thing, and the gate catches it four crossings later, after a hollow seal and two refusals. That is the right place to catch it and an expensive place to learn it. Worth a ticket; not cast yet.

B8 IS NOW MEASURED TWICE IN ONE DAY: the pre-commit reseal runs at a 120s wall-clock bound and test_hollow.py needs ~204s, so every cairn-repo commit this window printed a TIMEOUT that is not a red. Its ticket 3dfceaa272ec is cast and waiting.

STILL-UNCAST DEFECT CLASSES carried across several windows, none of them blocking: the commons-resolution class (~19 sites); the ref-existence defect at 157 berths; the hollow-roster class; the 11 tickets whose only BUILDME journal entry is a kick-back; the declared-teeth-vs-printed-teeth trap; /sail never tells the builder to pass proven_by (which is exactly what bit this voyage); instance-space bin copies shadowing class-space; 189 of 211 proofs carry a hand-rolled __main__ and 9 carry none; nothing stops a decompose berth naming a record in writes_to (SKIP_RECORD makes it harmless to hollow but does not stop the charting); the 54 legacy 'open' validations needing a one-time re-take.
